mara: FYI PR #517 updates the SDK examples and adds a migration note. Planning to merge after a quick preview sanity check. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/517

devin: I'll kick off link-check and glance at the preview. Local command I use: `pnpm docs:check-links` (or `yarn docs:linkcheck`).

lee: Netlify preview queued but failing with a 403 on /static/js/sdk.js during the build step. Vercel preview looks fine.

netlify-bot: Deploy report  site: redwood-docs, deploy id: 7f9c21, status: failed, logs: Error: EACCES while copying static assets

mara: Sounds like the cache issue again. Can someone clear Netlify build cache or add `--no-cache` to the build command temporarily? I prefer not to merge until both previews show the migration page and examples.

devin: I cleared the Netlify cache and retriggered. Also ran the link-check locally: one external old-blog redirect flagged, marked as allowed in config.

netlify-bot: Deploy succeeded  preview URL: https://deploy-preview-517--redwood-docs.netlify.app

lee: Preview looks good now. Examples render and SDK snippet hydrates. CI: link-check + build green.

ci-bot: docs-preview workflow completed  link-check: passed, build: passed, deploy-preview: succeeded

mara: Thanks all. I'll merge at 22:40 UTC, will monitor docs-alert for 20 minutes post-merge. Follow-up: add a small CI smoke test to curl /migration and /sdk/examples after deploy.

devin: Approved.
